'''House Damodred''' is a major [[nobility|noble]] [[house]] of [[Cairhien]], in fact one of the few royal houses able for a while to rule this kingdom. [[Elayne Trakand]] is a descendant of this house through her father, [[Taringail Damodred]].

The sigil for this house is the Tree and Crown and its colors are red, green and white.

==Notable members==
* [[Moiraine Damodred]] - [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]].
* [[Laman Damodred]] - once-king of [[Cairhien]], deceased during the Aiel War.
* [[Barthanes Damodred]] - cousin of Laman, once-High Seat and [[Darkfriend]], now deceased.
* [[Caraline Damodred]] - cousin of Moiraine and current High Seat of the house, currently in [[Tear]] as wife of King [[Darlin Sisnera]]
* [[Taringail Damodred]] - half-brother of Moiraine, initially consort to Daughter-Heir [[Tigraine Mantear]] and later to Queen [[Morgase Trakand]] of Andor, now deceased. Father of Galadedrid, Elayne and [[Gawyn]] [[Trakand]]
* [[Galadedrid Damodred]] - current Lord Captain Commander of the [[Children of the Light]].

==Other members==
* [[Aldecain Damodred]] - brother of Laman and uncle of Moiraine, now deceased.
* [[Moressin Damodred]] - brother of Laman and uncle of Moiraine, now deceased.
* [[Anvaere Damodred]] - older sister of Moiraine.
* [[Innloine Damodred]] - older sister of Moiraine.
* [[Dalresin Damodred]] - father of Taringail, Moiraine, Anvaere and Innloine.
* [[Carewin Damodred]] - Moiraine's great-grandmother and once-queen of Cairhien.

==Activities==
*'''[[Aiel War]]''' - In [[976 NE]], the Aiel War was directly provoked by King Laman Damodred cutting the tree ''[[Chora#Avendoraldera|Avendoraldera]]'' to build himself a magnificent throne. The Aiel invasion of the Westlands raged for three years, but came to an unexpected halt after King Laman died in battle.
*'''[[Wars of Cairhienin Succession|Fourth War of Cairhienin Succession]]''' - The Fourth War of Cairhienin Succession was triggered by the death of King Laman without a clear heir. His nephew Taringail was barred from the throne by law; his niece Moiraine rejected the throne, and other relatives were considered unsuitable. House Damodred was supplanted by [[House Riatin]] as the royal house under King [[Galldrian Riatin]], although remained a powerful and influential house in the nation.
*'''Fifth War of Cairhienin Succession''' - The Fifth War of Cairhienin Succession raged after the bitter rivals King Galldrian Riatin and Lord Barthanes Damodred sent assassins after each other on the same night, with both men being killed. When [[Rand al'Thor]] seized control in the nation, the new High Seat, Lady Caraline Damodred opposed the forces of the [[Dragon#Dragon Reborn|Dragon Reborn]], but eventually changed her mind. The next monarch to sit the [[Sun Throne]] was Queen [[Elayne Trakand]], also of [[Andor]], who claimed the throne through the right of her late father. [[Elmindreda Farshaw|Min Farshaw]] had a viewing that Lady Caraline would marry [[Darlin Sisnera]], the first King of Tear.

==Trivia==
The sigil of the House could possibly be a homage to the Kingdom of Gondor from J.R.R. Tolkien's ''The Lord of the Rings'' novel, which also features a tree and a crown on its banner.
